characters.name: Pearl Casey
characters.arc: protagonist — wants to prove she is more than her father’s daughter
characters.voice: sharp, clipped, uses humor as armor

characters.name: Sergeant Michael Doyle
characters.arc: supporting ally/NYPD — wants to keep his precinct clean but is bound by bureaucracy —  — — Active Arc: Doyle intercepts a warrant served to Pearl by Halloway, burning it to buy her time, driven by his own guilt over failing to protect her father initially.
characters.voice: weary, gravelly, uses Irish lilt sparingly

characters.name: Silas Vane
characters.arc: supporting antagonist/Industrialist — wants to monopolize transit contracts —  — — Active Arc: Vane attempts to bribe Pearl with a job offer at the new depot, trying to co-opt her skills, unaware she is investigating his former partners.

characters.name: Astrid Blackwell
characters.arc: supporting antagonist/Widow/Syndicate Head — wants to maintain her empire through silence —  — — Active Arc: Astrid hosts a charity gala where she publicly humiliates Pearl, using social etiquette as a weapon to isolate her before the physical attack.

characters.name: Elena Rossi
characters.arc: supporting ally/Seamstress — wants to feed her children —  — — Active Arc: Elena recognizes the specific stitching pattern on Pearl’s father’s coat in her shop window display, realizing the danger she is in, and locks her doors.

characters.name: Man in Grey Coat
characters.arc: supporting antagonist/Enforcer — wants to execute orders silently —  — — Active Arc: The Man in Grey Coat stalks Pearl through the subway tunnels, not attacking immediately but forcing her to take a longer, more dangerous route home.

settings.name: Grand Central Depot
settings.description: A cathedral of iron and glass; the smell of ozone and expensive tobacco clings to the marble steps where the body was found.

settings.name: Astrid Blackwell’s Townhouse
settings.description: Fifth Avenue opulence; the air is thick with the scent of beeswax and stale lilies, muffling sound.

settings.name: Elena’s Tenement Basement
settings.description: Cramped and damp; the smell of boiled cabbage and wet wool hangs heavy in the single room.

settings.name: Wall Street Rooftop
settings.description: Wind-battered and cold; the smell of coal smoke and river mud rises from the streets far below.

plot_points.description: Pearl finds her father dying; the blood-written name "Astrid Blackwell" is planted.
Pearl examines the knot; realizes it is a signature of the syndicate’s original master, not Vane.
Pearl is attacked in the theater; the attacker wears gloves indoors, signaling the Man in Grey Coat.
Pearl discovers her father wasn’t hunting Blackwell; he was protecting her from the inside.
Pearl confronts Astrid on the rooftop; the truth about the knot’s origin is revealed.
Pearl burns the evidence, choosing to let the law fail rather than expose her father’s secret compromise.

themes: the illusion of safety in high society.
voice: Close third-person past tense, clipped and observant, filtering forensic detail through the lens of textile analysis and urban decay.
